stop.prompt: Pause before you react, reply, or share anything.
stop.why: Quick reactions and resharing can spread the content further and make it harder to contain.

preserve.prompt: Save what you can see before it disappears — screenshots, links, usernames, and when you first noticed it.
preserve.why: A clear record helps whoever you tell understand what happened without needing to hunt for it later.

choose_contact.prompt: Choose who to tell. Pick the option that feels safest right now.
choose_contact.why: You do not have to handle this alone. One clear next step is enough.

template_trusted_adult.prompt: Use this message as a starting point. Edit it so it sounds like you before you send it.

template_school_contact.prompt: Use this message as a starting point. Edit it so it sounds like you before you send it.

template_platform_report.prompt: Use these notes when you file the platform report. Adjust details so they match what you saw.

resources.prompt: You've taken important steps. When you're ready, these organizations can help with removal, reporting, or talking to someone.
